title: Cleverly Breaking the Stalemate
next_chapter_hook: Just as Chen Ji believed his scheme was flawless, a familiar black mist swept across the imperial capital's sky—Ye Qing's aura, appearing at the wrong time in the wrong place.

text.content: Su Qingyao's fingertips trembled slightly within her sleeve. That momentary glimpse of his composure slipping told her more clearly than any words—thistrashdisciple was far more cunning than anyone imagined. She remained silent, her gaze buried deep in her teacup, waiting for Chen Ji to turn around on his own. She understood that some secrets, once even a corner is exposed, can never be hidden again.

dialogue.content: (Turning around, his expression already restored to its usual state, the customary timid curve on his lips) Why hasn't Senior Sister left yet? It's getting late. The mountain path at night is treacherous...
(Setting down the teacup, his gaze sharp as a blade) What were you just thinking about?
(Eyes flickering, then a simple honest smile) I was thinking about tomorrow's servant work. The senior brothers said the spirit herbs on the Rear Mountain need fertilizing...

text.content:
Su Qingyao stared at him for three breaths, then suddenly stood up. The wind from her skirts almost brushed Chen Ji's cheek. She said nothing, turning to leave, only pausing at the doorway.

"Chen Ji, you can fool everyone, but you can't fool me."

Her footsteps faded into the distance. Chen Ji kept that simple, honest smile on his face until Su Qingyao's aura completely disappeared into the night. Only then did he slowly raise his hand, pressing against his chest. It ached隐隐ly, like a fine needle pricking.

(Heavenly Fate -5, Current Remaining: XXX)

The Tianji Record Fragment burned slightly in his Mental Sea. In that moment—he had glimpsed the danger Su Qingyao would face tomorrow. The strategist from the Crown Prince's residence had already set his sights on the Inner Sect Senior Fellow of Tianqing Sect.

The next day. The side hall of the Crown Prince's residence.

Chen Ji stood with his head lowered in the corner, every part of him screaming 'afraid to look anyone in the eye.' Before him stood a middle-aged strategist in brocade robes, surname Zhao, called 'Zhao Half-Immortal'—it was said eight out of ten decisions in the Crown Prince's residence came from this man's mind.

"So you're that..." Zhao Half-Immortal raised his teacup, his gaze sweeping over Chen Ji, a barely perceptible contempt curling his lips, "trash?"

dialogue.content: (Shoulders shrinking, voice thin as a mosquito's buzz) Y-yes... Little Chen Ji, kowtowing to see Mr. Zhao...

(The teacup in his hand 'accidentally' tilted, scalding tea splashing across his palm, yet Chen Ji flinched back as if severely burned, constantly apologizing) Sorry, sorry! My hands are clumsy, I can't serve people properly!

text.content:
Zhao Half-Immortal frowned, setting his teacup down heavily. The attendant beside him immediately stepped forward to wipe the table, his disdain for Chen Ji unconcealed.

"Enough." Zhao Half-Immortal waved his hand, "I'm merely curious. The representative Tianqing Sect sent this time turns out to be such... merchandise." When he said 'merchandise,' his tone was as casual as discussing an object.

Chen Ji kept his head lowered, but a cold glint flickered in his eyes.

(Remembered. I'll make you kneel and beg me later.)

But on the surface, his spine curved even lower, like a startled quail.

dialogue.content:
(Voice trembling) Y-yes, yes, little one understands, I'll take my leave now...

(Turning to leave, he 'accidentally' bumped into the door frame, his forehead reddening, eyes teary and looking even more pathetic)

text.content:
Zhao Half-Immortal watched that stumbling departing figure, coldly snorting: "Tianqing Sect has no one left? Sending suchtrashto fill the numbers."

The attendant beside him flattering said: "Sir is wise. In this one's view, this Chen Ji isn't even as good as a street beggar. He's probably less presentable than even the gatekeepers of the Crown Prince's residence."

Zhao Half-Immortal stroked his beard and smiled, his contempt in his eyes deepening. What he didn't know was that at the very moment he spoke those words, Chen Ji had already circled to the secret passage entrance behind the side hall.

There, a perpetually burning ghostly blue fire waited for him.

—The contact signal of the Demonic Path's hidden operative.

The ghostly blue fire flickered in the depths of the secret passage, Chen Ji's footsteps casting a thin, long shadow in that glow. His posture had changed—the fawning, pathetic demeanor from before was completely gone, replaced by a composed, even elegant gait.

In the firelight, a graceful figure loomed indistinctly.

"The Holy Son is punctual." That voice was cold as frost, carrying a hint of mockery, "The act you performed at the Crown Prince's residence, this servant could smell the sourness from three streets away."

dialogue.content: (Black mist dissipating, Ye Qing's true form revealed, eyebrow raised slightly) ThetrashChen sure has refined his act. Planning to switch careers to the opera stage?

(Hands clasped behind back, a faint smile curling his lips) Ye Qing Shengnv's focus is quite unique. Anyone else would ask why I dare conduct a secret meeting with you right under the Crown Prince's residence's nose. Yet you only care about my acting.

It seems the Holy Sect's days have truly bored you to death.

text.content:
A dangerous light flickered in Ye Qing's eyes, but it was immediately masked by a light laugh. She stepped forward, black mist coiling serpentine around her form.

"Let's talk business." Her voice cooled, "You want me to use the 'Demonic Path Mist' to conceal the Tianji Record's aura. Fine. But what will you give me in exchange?"

Chen Ji drew a yellowed fragment from his sleeve. In the ghostly light, the patterns on that fragment writhed like living things.

The Third Page of the Tianji Record.

Incomplete, but enough to drive any cultivator mad.

"This is the deposit." Chen Ji's voice was terrifyingly calm, "Help me conceal my aura three times, and this fragment is yours. After three times, we're even."

dialogue.content: (Reaching out to take it, yet pausing the instant before touching the fragment) Aren't you afraid I'll take the goods and not deliver?

(Gently placing the fragment on her fingertip) Because Ye Qing Shengnv have no choice.

(Taking a step back, tone indifferent) The蛊毒the Holy Sect injected into you activates once a year. The next episode is in three months. I know where the解药is.

Of course, you could kill me and forcibly seize the fragment. But before I die, I'll destroy it, and Ye Qing Shengnv... will die from toxin relapse.

Is this deal a losing one?

text.content:
A brief, deathly silence settled in the secret passage.

Ye Qing stared at Chen Ji, those eyes churning with complex emotions—rage, surprise, and a hint of... admiration?

"Chen Ji." She suddenly laughed, that smile like honey laced with poison, "You're the most dangeroustrashI've ever met."

She tucked the fragment into her sleeve, black mist churning around her.

"Deal. But I have an附加条款—"

Her voice suddenly dropped, carrying an inexplicable undertone.

"When the agreement's conditions are triggered, regardless of where you are or what you're doing, you must let me appear."

Chen Ji narrowed his eyes: "What condition?"

"You'll know when the time comes." Ye Qing's figure began merging into the darkness, leaving only a meaningfully cryptic phrase, "I hope when that day comes... you can still smile."

After Ye Qing's aura had completely vanished, Chen Ji stood motionless for a long while.

His fingers unconsciously rubbed against his sleeve cuff, where the residual warmth of the Tianji Record Fragment still lingered. The agreement's terms... what exactly was this woman guarding against?

(智谋+3, Currentstrategy: XXX)

He had no time to ponder. The play at the Crown Prince's residence wasn't finished, and the Princess Faction's spies were probably already en route.

Chen Ji took a deep breath, the timid, pathetic mask sliding back on. He walked out of the secret passage with bowed shoulders, looking exactly like a rat that had stolen oil.

Only, no one saw that turning corner smile—faint, barely perceptible.

—借势, 离间, endured. Three steps of chess, each advancing the overall strategy.

The rift between the Crown Prince's residence and the Princess Faction would start from this "trash."

dialogue.content:
(Returning to the banquet, precisely colliding with an elegantly dressed woman) Oh no! This one is该死! Blind as a bat!

(Kneeling on the ground, continuously kowtowing, the bump on his head still swollen, now reddened from the kowtows)

The woman frowned, looking at Chen Ji on the ground. Just as she was about to flare up, she saw an attendant beside her whisper something into her ear. Her expression instantly shifted—

"So you're that 'trash' from Tianqing Sect." Her tone carried a playful edge, "The Crown Prince's residence really pulls weight, eventrashcan attend banquets."

Chen Ji kept his head lowered, but his eyes were icy cold.

(Princess Faction's person. Interesting.)

choice.prompt: The Princess Faction's woman is publicly humiliating you before the crowd. How will you respond?

choices.text: Continue pretending to be weak, let her become arrogant and careless
choices.description: Maintain thetrashpersona, let her act the more domineering—the higher you raise someone, the harder they fall.
choices.visible_reward: Princess Faction underestimates you + Crown Prince's residence holds a grudge
choices.risk_hint: If the performance goes too far, might really be stepped on to death in public

text.content:
Chen Ji lay prostrate on the ground, his posture as humble as could be. The Princess Faction's woman seemed very satisfied with this reaction, covering her mouth to laugh, her voice pretty but jarring.

"Fine, looking at your可怜样子, this young lady can't be bothered to argue with you." She turned to the attendant beside her, "Go tell the Crown Prince's residence people, just say this young lady helped them clean up the垃圾, no need to thank."

Snickering sounds came from all around, countless disdainful gazes falling on Chen Ji. He remained sprawled out, shoulders faintly trembling—

But if someone had seen his face, they would have found not a trace of humiliation, only cold calculation.

(Good. Continue.)

choices.text: Unintentionally reveal a bit of skill, let her suffer a hidden loss
choices.description: Still pathetic on the surface, but secretly set up obstacles, making her lose face publicly yet leaving no evidence.
choices.visible_reward: Princess Faction suffers a loss + both sides mutually suspicious
choices.risk_hint: Performance痕迹too obvious might be noticed by Su Qingyao

text.content:
Chen Ji 'panicked' trying to stand up, yet in that moment of rising, a small stone secretly slipped from his sleeve.

That stone precisely struck the woman's tiptoe. She shrieked, her body swaying, spilling an entire cup of tea and wine all over herself.

"Oh!" Chen Ji 'scared' until his face turned ashen, "Miss, forgive me! This one该死!"

The woman's face was livid with anger, yet she could find no evidence—the stone was too small and unremarkable, Chen Ji's expression too genuinely terrified.

She could only glare hatefully at Chen Ji, departing hastily surrounded by her maidservants.

(Hmph. Is this what they call noble temperament?)

choices.text: Use a borrowed knife, let the Crown Prince's residence stand up for you
choices.description: Deliberately say some ambiguous things, making the Crown Prince's residence strategist think the Princess Faction is provoking, prompting them to act first.
choices.visible_cost: Incur a debt of gratitude to the Crown Prince's residence
choices.visible_reward: Rift between two factions intensifies + reap the benefits
choices.risk_hint: Zhao Half-Immortal might see through your intentions

text.content:
Chen Ji 'trembling' 'hiding' behind the Crown Prince's residence strategist, his voice weak yet恰好loud enough for those nearby to hear:

"Gentlemen of the Crown Prince's residence, this, this one really didn't mean to bump into anyone..."

He deliberately emphasized the words 'Crown Prince's residence,' while his gaze 'casually' swept toward the Princess Faction woman—that look carried a hint of provocation. Stupid people couldn't see it, but Zhao Half-Immortal certainly could.

Indeed, Zhao Half-Immortal's expression darkened. He stepped forward, his smile not reaching his eyes as he cupped his fists toward the woman:

"This lady sure has a bad temper. Guests invited by my Crown Prince's residence don't need outsiders to lecture."

The atmosphere between the two sides instantly became tense as a bowstring.

And Chen Ji had already quietly retreated to a corner, munching on snacks while watching the show.

(Wonderful. Dogs fighting, both getting hurt.)

The banquet's gunpowder smell grew thicker and thicker.

The dispute between the Crown Prince's residence and the Princess Faction escalated from verbal conflict to physical. Both sides' attendants were already rolling up their sleeves. Zhao Half-Immortal's face was ashen—he clearly hadn't expected things to develop to this point—and the mastermind behind it all was currently huddled in a corner, nibbling on a piece of osmanthus cake, expression satisfied as a cat that had stolen the cream.

"Enough!"

A stern shout came from the host's seat. The manager of the Crown Prince's residence finally appeared. He glanced at the chaotic scene, his gaze lingering on Chen Ji for a moment, a hint of doubt flickering in his eyes.

"All guests have traveled far to be here. Why must we harm harmony over something so trivial?"

He clapped his hands, signaling attendants to separate the two factions. The Crown Prince's residence and Princess Faction people各自退开, yet the hostility between them was written plainly on their faces.

Chen Ji lowered his eyes, the curve of his lips hidden in shadow.

(The first move is done.)

Now, he just needed to wait for this seed to take root and sprout.

dialogue.content:
(Seizing the chaos, Chen Ji quietly left the banquet, stopping behind a fake rock in the Crown Prince's residence's back garden)

He raised his eyes toward the horizon. The sunset was like blood, dyeing the entire imperial capital in golden red.

In three days, a major event would occur in the imperial capital.

The rift between the Crown Prince's residence and the Princess Faction had been planted, but it wasn't enough. He needed to add more fuel, making this fire burn hotter and more thoroughly.

By then, the imperial court's attention would be firmly fixed on these two forces, with no leisure to attend to Tianqing Sect—much less to him, this "trash."

(And I... can lay my plans in the chaos.)

He closed his eyes briefly. The Tianji Record Fragment hummed in his Mental Sea. Every glimpse of the future came at a cost of five Heavenly Fate points. But for the sake of his布局, this consumption was worth it.

text.content:
Just as he turned to leave, a familiar black mist surged from the ground without warning.

Chen Ji's pupils contracted sharply.

Ye Qing's figure materialized from the black mist, but her expression was grave beyond anything she'd shown before.

"Chen Ji." Her voice was low, "The first condition of our agreement... has been triggered."

Chen Ji's brow furrowed tightly: "What does that mean? I haven't used your 'Demonic Path Mist' yet."

"It wasn't triggered by you." Ye Qing stepped forward, black mist churning like tides beside her, "Someone... is looking for you."

She raised her hand, pointing toward the eastern side of the imperial capital. That direction led to the imperial palace's restricted area, off-limits to ordinary people.

"Inside the palace, someone is using ancient forbidden arts to deduce your location."

Chen Ji's heart plummeted.

"And I must appear when conditions are triggered—"

Ye Qing's voice suddenly carried an inexplicable emotion.

"So, I have no choice but to appear now."

Before the words even finished, the black mist completely dissipated. Ye Qing stood shoulder to shoulder with Chen Ji—to outsiders, it looked like...

Standing together openly.

Chen Ji felt suffocated.

This woman, forced to expose herself before everyone. And those eyes watching him probably also saw—\
